description: Heuristic risk assessment for a token: contract-level checks (honeypot, mintable, ownership, taxes, holder concentration, LP lock) where a contract address is known on a supported chain, plus market signals (liquidity, cap, age, volatility) and provenance. Returns a 0–100 risk score (higher = riskier), a level, and the individual signals with explanations. Accepts the same identifiers as get_token.

chain.description: Chain hint when passing a contract address

token.description: CoinGecko id, symbol, name, or contract address

name: get_risk_signals
title: Get risk signals
